title: What Texture Engineering Labs Is
definition: Texture Engineering Labs: labs engineering the feel of future foods.

title: The Signature Vision: Texture Engineering Labs
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Texture Engineering Labs.

definition: 2030 milestone on the Texture Engineering Labs roadmap.
description:
First lab hulls products reach price parity: texture rigs cultivation at commercial scale.

What must be true first: the texture rigs results have to replicate outside the lab, lab logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and mouthfeel metrics operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed texture rigs demonstrations, lab logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting mouthfeel metrics uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Texture Engineering Labs
definition: Estimates Texture Engineering Labs readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Texture Engineering Labs components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a lab hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

description:
The simulator walks a Texture Engineering Labs installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 1803 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where texture rigs monitoring, lab logistics redundancy, or mouthfeel metrics maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Texture Engineering Labs Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Texture Engineering Labs: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Texture Engineering Labs — labs engineering the feel of future foods.

Phase 1 — Prove (texture rigs): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (lab logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (mouthfeel metrics): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (consumer tests): lab hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and food science-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
